correctness.rationale: The Markov generator yields H_s=p(1-exp(-s t)), P_s'=cH_s-lambda_s P_s. The comparison forcing has exactly one sign change because A/H_1 strictly decreases whereas P_1/H_1 strictly increases. Its integrating factor has exactly one positive zero using the strictly negative stationary gap. Resonance and e=0 are explicitly covered; 8,812 finite diagnostics corroborate the formula, not universal proof.

value.rationale: A fixed stationary habitat-suitability fraction can hide a universal early-vs-late occupancy ranking reversal. The exact one-crossing rule supplies a motivated finite-time monitoring benchmark and rules out reentrant preference in this canonical minimal dynamic habitat model; its proof needs global monotone-ratio reasoning rather than textbook stationary algebra.
